pages.text: Creates your persistent vault and opens it.

The vault is a KeePass file on the server, which only your game can open. Without $(1)password$(), your game asks you for a password and to repeat it. The password never leaves your game then. If you already have a persistent vault, the function raises VAULT_ALREADY_EXISTS. Closing the dialog raises VAULT_CANCELLED.
$(li)$(1)password$() STRING: the password (optional, default: ask the player)$(li)no results
